text:
marta: Quick sync: mobile console layout options — collapse left rail into FAB vs switch to bottom nav at <=720px. Also table overflow strategy for narrow screens? mock: https://img.redwood.local/mobile-console-alts.png

dinesh: Bottom nav wins for reachability. Keep Models as a primary tab. If using FAB, it's okay for admin actions but not for main nav.

kim: For tables: prefer horizontal scroll for 360-420px, card stack under 360px. Card stack keeps actions visible without kebab.

marta: Accessibility: ensure keyboard users can pan tables (prev/next buttons) and focus order remains logical in card view. Touch targets >=44px.

ux-bot: automated checks: contrast issue on dark theme for muted icons; suggest #DDEAF8. Also flag reduced-motion for nav animations.

dinesh: Implementation note: sticky first column + overflow-x:auto works, but add `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` to smooth scroll. Debounce swipe to avoid conflict with tab nav.

kim: Copy tweak: show name + version on two lines in compact rows to avoid ambiguity (e.g., "Redwood-Chat
v2").

marta: Timeline: kim can mock card layout + focus states by Wednesday; dinesh will prototype scroll behavior in Storybook. I'll schedule a 5-person usability quick test next Friday.

dinesh: I'll add acceptance criteria: breakpoint behaviors, touch targets, aria labels, contrast fix, reduced-motion respected.

marta: Thanks all — will update the ticket and link mocks.
